data.text: Gotcha (MC 26.3): PalettedContainer.read sizes global-palette storage from the CLIENT's block-state registry (Configuration$Global bitsInMemory), not wire bits. Rechiseled 1.2.6a adds ~108k states (1283 stairs x80) -> client 18 bits/3 per long (1366 longs) vs Paper server 15 bits/4 per long (1024 longs) -> IndexOutOfBoundsException in readFixedSizeLongArray on any section whose server palette went global (>256 entries, busy chunks) -> kick. Then Polytone 6.8.6 post chain (Sunbathing pack godrays/dof) NPEs on the disconnect frame (GlCommandEncoder.setupDraw bufferView null) -> full crash. Fix applied 2026-11-21: rechiseled jar renamed .disabled (no saves contained rechiseled blocks). Never run block-adding client mods on mchardcore (Paper 26.3).
